verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same and share the same faults. The lime panel is pushed against the right edge with an arbitrary gap on the left. There is a large dead area inside the panel between the headline and the body copy. The VOLTSTRIDE box, which is the hero product, has shrunk to a tiny fragment stuck to the left edge. The 48H ONLY badge is small and floats on its own. A's panel sits lower and leaves a thin bottom margin. B's panel sits higher and leaves a large stretch of empty stripes at the bottom. Neither difference is better or worse overall.
